in_sanskrit.name: Andhit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Fearless Warrior
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Andhit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Andhit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘an-dhit’, which means 'fearless' or 'unafraid'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with brave and courageous warriors, who fearlessly protect their people and values. Andhit is an ideal name for parents seeking to instill a sense of bravery and courage in their child.
